population_definition: Every hardware item in the asset inventory and every component in the SBOM/HBOM for systems in and adjacent to the CUI boundary, resolved to a manufacturer and cross-referenced against the covered-equipment list.
source_system: hardware asset inventory and SBOM/HBOM joined to the covered-equipment reference
coverage_basis: 1842 of 1842 components across the enclave asset inventory and adjacent SBOM/HBOM. Three components on one refurbished switch chassis cannot be resolved to a manufacturer. They are counted as FAILING, not dropped and not passed: an unresolved manufacturer is a variance, and treating it as absence of one would turn an incomplete answer into a clean bill of health.
